item.title: VIDEO | Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw (@AshwiniVaishnaw) inspects New Delhi Railway Station ahead of Diwali and Chhath. He says, "Every year, the ...
item.description:
VIDEO | Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw (@AshwiniVaishnaw) inspects New Delhi Railway Station ahead of Diwali and Chhath.

He says, "Every year, the festival season, which includes Durga Puja, Diwali and Chhath, is the period of maximum passenger rush. Therefore, we make an effort to introduce some improvements every year. Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi ji guides us to bring in new improvements every year. Last year, you saw that a holding area was created for unreserved passengers, which proved to be very beneficial. This year, at New Delhi Railway Station, a dedicated holding area has been created for reserved passengers as well. Earlier, there were six different entry gates, which often caused confusion among passengers. Instead of that arrangement, a common holding area has now been created. All the facilities for luggage checking have also been shifted outside. As a result, the area that was previously used for ticketing inside the station has now been converted into a comfortable waiting area. Overall, this new arrangement at New Delhi Railway Station has brought significant improvements for passengers. On average, the Delhi railway area handles more than 5 lakh passengers daily. During peak periods, such as today, the daily passenger traffic reaches around 8 lakh. Several arrangements have been made to accommodate these 8 lakh passengers, including additional special trains and extra deployment of RPF personnel. Along with setting up these holding areas, special attention has also been given to ensuring that passengers get their trains in the shortest possible time after arriving at the station. I was interacting with some passengers just now, and they expressed their satisfaction with the arrangements. Every year, we learn from our experiences and try to make further improvements to provide passengers with better facilities."

#Railway #NDLS #Diwali #Chhath

On the occasion of Diwali, i.e. 08th November 2026 (Sunday), Metro train services on the Pink Line (Majlis Park-Majlis Park/Shiv Vihar), Magenta Line (Botanical Garden - Krishna Park Ext. & Majlis Park – Deepali Chowk) and Grey Line (Dwarka Kakrola - Dhansa Bus Stand), which normally commence at 7:00 AM on Sundays, will begin one hour earlier at 6:00 AM from terminal stations.

item.description:
🇰🇷 🚨 2 MILLION KOREAN CONSUMER RECORDS WITH KAKAO/NAVER TOKEN FIELDS ALLEGEDLY FOR SALE

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be selling a 2 million-record South Korean consumer database. A sample table was posted. No victim organization, breach date, file list, or price was given. The claim is unverified.

What the sample allegedly contains:
• Names and nicknames
• Email addresses and phone numbers
• kakao_token and naver_token fields
• Account-type labels

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If authentic, contact data plus Kakao/Naver-related token fields could support phishing, smishing, account enumeration, and account-takeover attempts against Korean consumers — especially if any token values are live session or auth material (not confirmed). No company or platform is named, which complicates victim notification. Unverified threat-actor listing, NOT confirmation of a breach at any named service.

#DDW #DarkWeb #SouthKorea #Kakao #Naver #DataLeak #ThreatIntelligence

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be selling a consumer database belonging to Phone House España (Phonehouse[.]es). A sample of records was posted. No total record count, price, breach date, or exfiltration method was given. The claim is unverified.

What the sample allegedly contains:
• Internal ID and customer-type labels
• Code values resembling Spanish DNI/NIE identity-document numbers
• Email addresses and phone numbers
• Gender, first and last names, dates of birth
• Address, city, municipality, province, postal code, and country

If authentic, DNI/NIE-style identifiers combined with contact and address data are useful for phishing, smishing, identity fraud, and SIM-swap attempts against Spanish residents. Phone House has not confirmed an incident that we are aware of. Unverified threat-actor listing, NOT confirmation of a breach.

item.title: Backdoored ARTEX Docker images pulled from Docker Hub, but installs stay at risk ⚠️ BadByte says a trojanized image of ARTEX, the AI-driven penetrat...
item.description:
Backdoored ARTEX Docker images pulled from Docker Hub, but installs stay at risk ⚠️

BadByte says a trojanized image of ARTEX, the AI-driven penetration testing console abused in recent bank attacks, gave anyone who knew the trick a root shell. Commands sent through the login form's captcha field ran before the password was checked.

• 7,946 pulls of tomicdd/artex and congdonglinux/artex before disclosure
• 46 of 62 exposed consoles still served the backdoored build on Nov 4
• 637 GitHub repos still pointed their compose file at it
• Docker removed both images on Nov 5

Cheaper Cancer Medicines: What the New Margin Cap Means for Patients

▪️Affordable, quality cancer care for every family is a priority for the Government of India. On October 17, 2026, the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) capped the trade margin on 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer medicines, including patented ones, at 30% of the maximum retail price (MRP).

▪️The revised prices take effect on November 9, 2026. By November 4, 2026, 70 companies had reported revised MRPs for 120 drugs, with the highest reduction at 96.45% and estimated savings of Rs. 3,357.49 crore. MRP reductions average 20% to 70%.

"The portal will make it possible for everyone from around the globe who loves and respects Bhupen Hazarika to attend the two-hour programme at Bharat Mandapam, where Prime Minister Narendra Modi will be the chief guest," Sarma said.

Yedioth published the full statement:

"The election results oblige all of us to recalculate our route and understand that there are no good alternatives or magic solutions before us. To grasp the scale of the responsibility on us, and the price we could pay for wrong decisions, it is important to learn from past mistakes and look several moves ahead.

I defined clear boundaries:
1. We must put an end to the Netanyahu era.
2. We must not be dragged into another election.
3. We must not form a government that relies on the abstention of the Joint List and Ra'am.

On every other issue, it is permissible and desirable to be flexible, to compromise and to understand that if you grasp too much, you grasp nothing. That also includes the draft law.

It hurts me, and I know it hurts many others too. But given the many challenges we face today, the national interest of the State of Israel and the people of Israel must stand above every other consideration."
